title: Fix 361
acceptance_criteria: While an installed skill file is byte-identical to a known earlier bundle, chough doctor reports it as skill_outdated, naming the file and chough skill update, not a decision, and chough next shows the line 'Skill files are outdated: run chough skill update' and skill_outdated as the count; a current, missing or edited file gives neither, and chough skill update clears both. chough status carries no_native_change once the session recorded it.

answers.constraints: The specs/cli/cli.3md lessons apply: human gates are plain text in tasks.md and the delta is frozen at approval. Doctor writes no skill file (REQ-cli-016 keeps updates to chough skill update), and next reads only the installed copy's files.
